about: What an agent can do in each arm of the port twin, operation by operation. Made before a measurement is frozen; `parity.py check` holds it against the tools the harness really gives. A condition is the flags of the BMB arm's server and, under `rust`, the tools it adds to the Rust arm's.

operations.note: Rust: files and directories. BMB: units and their definitions.

operations.op: read the text of a definition
operations.note: Rust reads a line range of a file; BMB reads a definition with what it depends on.
Rust has no tool of its own for it: a search for `fn ` lines gives the first line of each signature.
Not equal: Rust searches with a regular expression and context lines, BMB with the text as written.

operations.op: callers and callees of a function
operations.note: Not equal: Rust finds call sites by name, BMB reads the call edges. This difference is part of what is measured.
Not equal: Rust replaces one occurrence of a text; BMB sends the whole definition again.

operations.op: rename a definition and every use in one call
operations.gap: A gap in the conditions where an arm lacks it. `port`: neither arm has it (Rust searches and edits place by place, BMB writes unit by unit); this is the control. `port-rename`: only BMB has it. `port-rename-both`: both have it (BMB `write` with `rename`, Rust `rename` through rust-analyzer), and refactoring is judged there. Not equal where both have it: BMB names the definition by its path and the change is checked and proved before it is taken; Rust names one occurrence by file, line and name, and the edit is not built.

operations.op: change a signature whose call sites are in several files or units, in one step
operations.gap: Rust may leave the crate broken between edits. BMB writes one unit at a time and each write must check, so the change goes through a second name (see the README, `Changes across units`).

operations.note: A BMB write is checked before it is taken.

operations.gap: The BMB arm cannot run anything. What it has in the place of tests is the next row.
The Rust arm has no prover. This difference is part of what is measured.

operations.op: run the program on an input
operations.gap: Neither arm. The hidden judge does it after the session.
